One night Tomo runs into Mikio Yabunuma – his wife’s boss, a swinger – and a twisted wish takes root: he wants to watch his wife, Sakumi, with another man. What begins as the husband’s fantasy becomes a chain he can no longer stop and drags them both into it.

title: Scapesir Final X
overview: Time has passed since Scapesir Final X mutated from an RPG into a visual novel. The game keeps releasing update after update, and with overviews like this, some people no longer know what to expect from it.

title: ADV: Slave Series I Chapter 1
overview: The protagonist rescues Sophia, a maid girl and former coworker who was being sold by a slave trader. The two then begin a precarious life together. But after a certain incident, he also meets Renoa, a demon girl he finds collapsed on the ground. Two girls with very different personalities and values. Who will you spend your limited time with, and what kind of relationship will you build? Your choices will lead the story to a variety of endings.

title: Fair-Skinned Big-Breasted Sister’s Curse Ritual Training
overview: Elysia, a lone priestess, has been dispatched to a certain small town. Her organization, the “Eld Kingdom Church,” is a group that sends clergy to towns and villages sacrificed during the Great War to provide reconstruction support for those affected by the conflict. While Elysia was sent to this small town for that same purpose, she also carries a secret, simultaneous mission: “The tracking and discovery of fragments of cursed magical weapons used in the Great War.” Even a mere fragment of a cursed weapon possesses enough power to wipe out an entire town with a hex; unless the weapons themselves are removed, the number of victims will never decrease. However, if rumors were to spread that such items were located in “that town,” it would lead to secondary disasters—therefore, the Church has carried out these orders in strict secrecy. Thus, Elysia’s mission begins. But will she truly be able to return from this town unscathed…?

title: King Of Brothels
overview: “King of Brothels” is an 3D adult based game featuring the most elaborate management gameplay with build high-graphics. You’ll get to manage your club and build it as you like while controlling the club’s policies, managing the club’s finances, hiring employees (men and women), bribing cops, dealing with the mafia, dealing with costumers and so on. But… managing an adult club has it’s benefits and you’ll get to enjoy the club you’ve built as well and you also need to test the girls before accepting them to work, don’t you?

title: Bouncing Boobs
overview: Take control of both hands in a first-person physics playground. Start gently, experiment with your approach, and watch her respond. Soft-body physics brings the bounce, while her voice and reactions tell you how things are going.

title: Lust Doll Plus
overview: Lust Doll Plus is set in a post-apocalyptic semi-modern/future world, where you start alone and confused in a dangerous place, with literally nothing (not even clothes on your back), and go on to carve out a piece of the world for yourself. There’ll be a main storyline to follow, but the emphasis is on it being an open world game where you just screw around and have fun. There’s a large emphasis on body configuration and gender identity. You choose who you want to be at the beginning, but your body may change over the course of the game, depending on your actions. You’ll also be able to control what kind of content you can see in the game. For example, if you wish for your character to have sex with only males or only females, or if you don’t want to see a particular kink, then you can disable them.

title: Curvy Town
overview: This is VN about a city in which everything changes at some point in the life of every girl. The player will have to meet these changes together with Sam.

title: Pinked and Owned
overview: Pinked and Owned is an adult HTML/browser narrative game about slow feminization and a life quietly rearranging itself. You play a guy with a small chastity cage, a complicated roommate, and the kind of job that keeps asking him to wear something new. Stat-driven sandbox, explore the city, build (or lose) your resolve, and watch the story branch based on choices you didn’t even realise were choices. Active solo dev, new content every 2-3 weeks.

title: Eroded Twins - The Downfall of the Empire
overview: Long ago, a war between humans and demons ravaged the continent until the Demon King was sealed away, bringing an end to the conflict. Now, three nations coexist in relative peace: the law-bound Celestia Empire, the commerce-driven Mercant Duchy, and the demon-inhabited region of Necrosia. At the heart of these territories lies the Kingdom of Edelwald, where a princess must risk everything to protect her kingdom.

title: Netorase Wife Training ~Letting Another Man Hold Her, Making Her Fall with My Fingers~
overview: You, the husband, will personally persuade your initially reluctant wife, Kasumi, to become involved with another man. Over twenty days, you send her out, await her return, and gradually reshape your once-harmonious marriage through your own actions. The game emphasizes the wife's perspective, interactive touch-based H-scenes, and the slow psychological deterioration of everyday married life.

title: Spellbound Command
overview: Build an army, bind heroes, increase bonds, and destroy the enemy. Spellbound Command combines tactical RTS with dating simulations and detailed visual novels.

title: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
overview: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

title: ERO FIGHTERS
overview: Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?! You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga. Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

title: OnlyRifts

title: REBELLIOUN
overview: A living NTR village sandbox that keeps moving even when you look away. Play a humble blacksmith under an occupying gang. Fifteen women, corrupted loyalties, dark secrets, dire consequences, pregnancy. Protect your wife and daughter at all costs... and the rest, if you can.

title: Entropy - The Struggle of Fate
overview: After a failed attack on the Frainnan village, Varnel is promptly captured by the enemy chief. Understanding his role in the ceremony, he makes peace with his fate, only for the chief to spare his life and keep him as a prisoner. For a reason or another, the Frainnan tries to assimilate him in their way of life.

title: Road of a Goddess 2
overview: Explore a stylish early preview of the scenic Las Diosas canals in the first level. Fight off initial enemies along the waterways and unlock new alternative outfits. The second scene traps the girls deep inside a dangerous, late-game mine level. Collect mysterious glowing elements to illuminate the pitch-black areas of the cavern. Test powerful new combat mechanics like the devastating forward-facing Milk Blast. Use Jacquelyn's spinning Sword Blender to shred groups of enemies and cross wide gaps. Execute Montse's heavy three-hit Hammer Combo to trap targets right in their tracks. Touch Montse during the combo to dynamically power up the damage of each strike. Get an exclusive hands-on look at the evolving gameplay, visuals, and tech features.
